case: Book chapter with a year-only `issued` date and no authors at all
note: cr-02. `issued.date-parts` is [[2023]], so published_date is the four characters `2023`. A month or a day would be fabricated. The chapter also has no `author` key whatsoever, which is a missing list, not an error. Three licences are deposited, two `tdm` and one `vor`; the version of record wins, so license_raw is the CC BY-NC-ND URL. That URL maps to `cc-nc-nd`: the register carries the exact URL, and the alias table is now seeded from every entry's `url` as well as its id and title (compliance-06 — by-nc mapped and by-nc-nd did not, which was an inconsistency rather than a policy). An unmappable licence is still `notspecified` with license_mapped FALSE, flagged in the run report, never quietly turned into something open.
